Unico activo a la venta de estas caracteristicas con arrendamiento asegurado en el Madrid de los Austrias, en plena Latina, la mejor zona de ocio nocturno y gastronomico de Madrid. Local exento de IBI.

-  Fachada: 8 metros con acceso directo desde la calle. Gran visibilidad.
-  Altura: 4.00 metros.
-  Rentabilidad: 5.40 %
-  Contrato: Larga duracion con buenas garantias e inquilino solvente.
-  Salida de humos: SI. Instalada.
-  Licencia: Bar especial Con aforo para 185 personas y horario especial de 17:00 - 05:30 AM.

inv.desc_en:
AURIGA Real Estate offers a magnificent rental property for investors, leased to a well-known and historic party and events venue in Madrid with over 40 years of operation, in an unbeatable tourist area with excellent pedestrian traffic. This is the only asset of its kind for sale with guaranteed tenancy in Madrid de los Austrias, in the heart of La Latina, the best nightlife and culinary area of Madrid. Property exempt from IBI.
-  Surface area: 236 m2. (122 m2 on the ground floor + 114 m2 in the semi-basement).
-  Facade: 8 meters with direct access from the street. Great visibility.
-  Height: 4.00 meters.
-  Yield: 5.40%
-  Contract: Long term with good guarantees and solvent tenant.
-  Smoke vent: YES. Installed.
-  License: Special bar with a capacity for 185 people and special hours from 5:00 PM to 5:30 AM.
-  Availability: IMMEDIATE. Sale with rental yield.

No specific address of the property or photos are provided at the owner's express request. The photos do not correspond to the property; they are of the surrounding area and are for orientation purposes only. For more information about the property and its conditions, do not hesitate to contact us without obligation. We also have more vacant properties and rental investments with the best operators and tenants, along with guarantees of rental agreements.
Directly from the Owner.
AURIGA Real Estate.
